q1.explanationZh: 后面的 those lines 需要前文交代是哪些诗句，E 说老师告诉大家这一年要背 400 行诗，正好对上。

evidence.quote: “I might ask any of you, at any time, to stand up and recite one of those lines,” he said.

q2.explanationZh: 前一句讲感受韵律和氛围，C 接着讲要理解诗的意思、发现它传达的信息，是更深一步的欣赏。

evidence.quote: He invited us to feel the rhythm and the mood.

q3.explanationZh: 前一句说这是济慈的《秋颂》，A 讲这首诗赞美的秋天的景色，后面 But 再讲它的另一层意思。

evidence.quote: But Keats also reminded us not to think too much about the future

q4.explanationZh: 后面写“我”为了背诗把自己锁在卧室里，前面应是同学们对背诗的反应，F 说大家自然会抱怨。

evidence.quote: I’d lock myself in my bedroom and go over a poem line by line until I could recite it by heart.

q5.explanationZh: 前一句说“我”熬过了八年级，后面 But 转折，所以 B 说上了高中依然浮躁，再引出秋天里背起诗句。

evidence.quote: But that fall, when the leaves started to turn their brilliant colours
